title: Grandmaster Rewards: Tailor, Alchemist and Enchanter

sections.heading: Three more Grandmaster rewards
items: Tailor (at 100): garments you make at a loom carry your mark, like "Fine Clothes, sewn by Endarie". For a commission, type /bespoke followed by the name the buyer wants, then make the garment: it carries that name and your mark.
Alchemist (at 100): once a day, type /signature and brew within ten minutes. That potion carries your name, like "Potion of Healing, brewed by Arcadia".
Enchanter (at 100): once a week, type /enchantname followed by a name, then enchant an item within ten minutes. It carries that name and your mark.
Once a day resets at midnight UTC. /capstone shows your reward and whether it is ready.
